# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
# mod-standard-access
tap id:case-mod-standard-access
# What the app did not declare rejects with ERR_ACCESS_DENIED; wrong uses
# with a TypeError (a bad URL of the global WebSocket throws SyntaxError).
expect Standard grants files=true tcp=true websocket=true global=true
covers [fs/promises] default
covers [fs/promises] readFile
covers [fs/promises] writeFile
covers [fs/promises] readdir
covers [fs/promises] exists
covers [fs/promises] unlink
covers [fs/promises] rmdir
covers [fs/promises] mkdir
covers [fs/promises] stat
covers [fs/promises] lstat
covers [fs/promises] rename
covers [fs/promises] readlink
covers [net] default
covers [net] connect
covers [websocket] default
covers [websocket] connect
covers [globals] WebSocket
covers [net] Socket
covers [websocket] WebSocketConnection
# mod-accessibility
tap id:case-mod-accessibility
# no screen reader and asks for no less motion.
expect Screen reader: false
expect Reduce motion: false
expect Calls: not called
tap id:call
expect Calls: done
covers [nsh] announce
covers [nsh] setAccessibilityFocus
covers [nsh] reduceMotion
covers [nsh] screenReaderEnabled
# mod-android
tap id:case-mod-android
# nsh/mobile's BackHandler does nothing there and the app runs on.
expect Android: false
expect Exit: function
expect Calls: not called
tap id:call
expect Calls: done, remove function
covers [nsh/mobile] BackHandler
# mod-clipboard
tap id:case-mod-clipboard
# the headless runtime: writes go through, reads are promises that stay
# pending (and none fails).
expect Calls: not called
expect Failed: none
tap id:copy
expect Calls: 5 promises
wait 300
expect Failed: none
covers [nsh] Clipboard
# mod-i18n
tap id:case-mod-i18n
# en-US shows English; a missing key reads as its locale and key; German
# formats with the data nsh.json lists, French (not listed) as English.
expect Shown: en-US
expect Hello: Hello
expect Greet: Hello, Ada!
expect Missing: en-US.missing
expect Asked: 你好
expect Locales: en zh zh-CN
expect German: 1.234,5
expect French: 1,234.5
tap id:chinese
expect Shown: zh-CN
expect Hello: 你好
expect Greet: 你好，Ada！
tap id:device
expect Shown: en-US
expect Hello: Hello
covers [nsh/i18n] t
covers [nsh/i18n] setLocale
covers [nsh/i18n] availableLocales
# mod-picker
tap id:case-mod-picker
# a pick is a promise that never throws: options out of range reject it with
# a RangeError; a pick no picker answers there stays pending.
expect Picked: not picked
tap id:pick
expect Refused: rejected RangeError
expect Picked: pending
wait 300
expect Picked: pending
expect Files: not picked
tap id:pick-files
expect Files refused: rejected RangeError
expect Files: pending
covers [nsh] Picker
# mod-speech
tap id:case-mod-speech
# nothing recognizes speech there: available() resolves false and a session
# ends at once with "unavailable"; a lang that is no tag throws a RangeError.
expect Available: false
expect Speech: not started
tap id:start
expect Refused: threw RangeError
expect Speech: end unavailable "" true
covers [nsh] Speech
# mod-audio
tap id:case-mod-audio
# nothing plays sound there: available() resolves false, a sound's load
# rejects and a player's play() rejects as its error listener hears
# "unavailable"; a volume out of range throws a RangeError.
expect Available: false
expect Sound: not loaded
# an imported audio file is its URL
expect Imported: asset:/sounds/click.wav
tap id:play
expect Refused: threw RangeError
expect Sound: rejected ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM
expect Bytes: rejected ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM
expect Player: rejected, error unavailable, idle true 1.5
covers [nsh] Sound
covers [nsh] AudioPlayer
# mod-notifications
tap id:case-mod-notifications
# nothing shows notifications there: the permission is unavailable and nothing
# shows, the badge and close do nothing, and bad arguments reject.
expect Permission: unknown
tap id:notify
expect Permission: unavailable unavailable
expect Refused: RangeError RangeError
expect Shown: false false
covers [nsh] Notifications
# mod-app-info
tap id:case-mod-app-info
# `nsh build --release` of an app whose nsh.json has a version and build:
# a release build, its information there before any module runs.
expect App: com.example.api-modules API Modules
expect Version: 1.2.3 build 7
expect Development: false
expect Early: 1.2.3
covers [nsh] appInfo
# mod-url-scheme
tap id:case-mod-url-scheme
# the domain claims `compat`: no link opened it, and the listener stops.
# The app's own `setUrl` is no change of the address it did not make.
expect Links: none
expect Listener: listening
expect Address: null
expect Changes: none
tap id:set-url
expect Address: compat://orders/43, wrong TypeError TypeError TypeError
expect Changes: none
tap id:stop-links
expect Listener: stopped
covers [nsh] UrlScheme
# mod-updater
tap id:case-mod-updater
# no packaged app: no package runs, none is offered, there is nothing to
# download or restart into, and the shell has no packaged version.
expect Running package: none
expect Shell: none build none, packages false
expect NSH version: semver
expect Check: null
expect Download: rejected
expect Restart: rejected
covers [nsh/updater] checkForPackage
covers [nsh/updater] downloadPackage
covers [nsh/updater] restartToPackage
covers [nsh/updater] runningPackage
covers [nsh/updater] shellInfo
# mod-desktop
tap id:case-mod-desktop
# no title bar area, the main window is the only one, a window of the app's
# own neither renders nor opens, the window, app and menu functions do
# nothing, and a popup closes at once.
expect Desktop: false
expect Title bar: 0 0 0
expect Window state: null displays 0
expect Current: main true null state null
expect Windows: main focused null get true null
absent Inside a window
expect Calls: not called
expect Popup: not shown
tap id:window
expect Calls: window done, open ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM, close function
tap id:menu
expect Calls: menu done
expect Popup: closed
tap id:application
expect Calls: application done, quit function, restart function, stop function
covers [nsh/desktop] isAvailable
covers [nsh/desktop] titleBar
covers [nsh/desktop] windowState
covers [nsh/desktop] displays
covers [nsh/desktop] Window
covers [nsh/desktop] currentWindow
covers [nsh/desktop] windows
covers [nsh/desktop] focusedWindow
covers [nsh/desktop] Menu
covers [nsh/desktop] Application
# mod-device
tap id:case-mod-device
# iOS phone at 1 pixel per point, in the light scheme.
expect Platform: ios
expect OS: ios
expect Idiom: phone
expect Desktop: false
expect Catalyst: false
expect Version: 0.0
expect Select: ios
expect Select mobile: mobile
expect Ratio: 1
expect Font scale: 1
expect Window: 390x844
expect Scheme: light
expect Lifecycle: active
expect Time zone: UTC
expect Intl local time: its zone
expect Languages: en-US
expect Regional: h12, week from 7, us, fahrenheit
tap id:dark
expect Scheme: dark
absent Scheme: light
tap id:system
expect Scheme: light
# openUrl: a promise for a web page, rejected with a TypeError for a
# `javascript:` URL.
expect Open: not opened
tap id:open
expect Open: function, refused TypeError
covers [nsh] openUrl
covers [nsh] platform
covers [nsh] pixelRatio
covers [nsh] colorScheme
covers [nsh] setColorScheme
covers [nsh] fontScale
covers [nsh] windowSize
covers [nsh] lifecycle
covers [nsh] localeSettings
# mod-host-channel
tap id:case-mod-host-channel
# no embedding app: no parameters, posts go nowhere and calls reject at
# once with ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM.
expect Params: 0 object
expect Calls: not called
expect Call failed: none
tap id:call
expect Calls: function, post done
expect Call failed: Error ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM
covers [nsh] host

# mod-mobile
tap id:case-mod-mobile
expect Mobile: true
# The system's bar, in the frame the app's style gives it; the app owns
# which tab is selected and follows the user's choice (`onChange`).
expect Tab: 0
frame id:tab-bar 0 784 390 60
tap id:tab-next
expect Tab: 1
tap id:tab-rename
frame id:tab-bar 0 784 390 60
covers [nsh/mobile] isAvailable

# mod-haptics
tap id:case-mod-haptics
# every call goes through; a name Haptics does not know throws.
expect Haptics: not called
tap id:play
expect Haptics: done, loud refused: TypeError
covers [nsh/mobile] Haptics
# mod-storage
tap id:case-mod-storage
# a key set twice keeps its last value, and a missing key reads null.
expect Storage empty
tap id:set
expect Storage set: a=1,b=two missing=null
tap id:remove
expect Storage removed: a=1 missing=null
tap id:clear
expect Storage cleared: none missing=null
# A value past the quota rejects with a code and is not kept.
tap id:full
expect Storage full: Error ERR_NSH_QUOTA_EXCEEDED kept=false
covers [nsh] Storage
# mod-host
tap id:case-mod-host
# no host on this platform: the call rejects at once with
# ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM; the root's events reach the listener.
expect Host available: false
expect Host call: not called
tap id:call
expect Host call: rejected Error ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM
event id:heard onHost type=event event=tick payload=1
expect Host heard: [1]
# Stopped, the listener hears no more.
tap id:stop
event id:heard onHost type=event event=tick payload=2
wait 50
expect Host heard: [1]
covers [nsh] host
# mod-web
tap id:case-mod-web
# No page here: a head renders nothing, before and after its props change.
expect Title: Notes
tap id:retitle
expect Title: Q3 earnings
covers [nsh/web] Head
# mod-fps
tap id:case-mod-fps
# no performance monitor headless: it reports none, and the calls go through.
expect Fps enabled: false
expect Calls: not called
tap id:toggle
expect Calls: done
expect Fps enabled: false
covers [nsh] fpsEnabled
covers [nsh] setFpsEnabled
